{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Claw}}
A '''tree-claw''' was a crampon-style climbing tool used by [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] in the forests of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. They were attached to the feet so as to keep the hands free for balance, combat, or harvesting [[Rikknit/Legends|rikknit]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
